# Decisions Log

> **Charter:** doc-routing rules live in [CHARTER.md](CHARTER.md) — one fact, one home; pointers everywhere else.

Append-only log of architectural and product decisions. Newest entries at top.

## 2026-07-08 [process]: Founder discovery interview opens on stories — /feed positions move to Act 3, gated on pull

**Context:** Prepping the first H-FounderWince interview (a warm founder contact). The live run-sheet in `.private/docs/business/discovery-questions.md` had opened the call on the /feed diagnostic positions the interviewee sets ahead of time.

**Decision:** Restructure the run-sheet into 4 acts: **Act 1 opens on general stories** about gaps in understanding (their world, their domains, what "understood" means to them, importance + influence) — no positions, no diagnostic. A **pull-gate** follows (flat → stop; a flat is data, not a cue to sell). **Act 2** probes their model + the status-norm (H-NormFlip) + new **epistemic-safety** questions (last time you withheld something true out of fear of being misread; when you discount others' advice suspecting a gap). The **/feed positions enter only in Act 3**, as story doorways, and only if they went deeper. Act 4 = pull signal → costly-yes close. Also de-bloated the doc (cut generic Universal-qualifiers + duplicate Phase-2 questions absorbed by the run-sheet) and linked all cross-references.

**Alternatives rejected:** Positions-first opener — it pre-frames the entire call around our construct before we know the pain is even felt; it's a narrowing move applied before qualifying. Also rejected: adversarial-review of the question set now — the questions were brainstormed, not hard-won; review against real transcripts after 1–2 interviews instead.

**Consequences:** All pilot interviews open story-first; positions become a doorway, not the frame. **UNTESTED** — falsifier: if founders don't wince/pull under the story-first flow, the flow (not the mechanism) is the first suspect. Canonical run-sheet: `.private/docs/business/discovery-questions.md` (gitignored).

**References:** `.private/docs/business/discovery-questions.md`, [hypotheses.md](hypotheses.md) (H-FounderWince)

## 2026-07-08 [infra]: www.claritypledge.com cert error → apex set as canonical domain, www 308-redirects via vercel.json host match

**Context:** A customer WhatsApp'd a screenshot of Safari's "This Connection Is Not Private / This website may be impersonating www.claritypledge.com" error. Root cause: DNS had a wildcard (`*`) CNAME pointing all subdomains, including `www`, at All-Inkl (`w00dd4f1.kasserver.com`) instead of Vercel — so `www` served All-Inkl's `*.kasserver.com` Sectigo cert (CN mismatch) instead of a cert covering `www.claritypledge.com`. MX (email) was unaffected by this record.

**Decision:** Repoint DNS wildcard CNAME to `cname.vercel-dns.com` and A record to `76.76.21.21` (user made this change directly in the All-Inkl KAS panel), then add `www.claritypledge.com` as a domain in the Vercel project. Verified at origin via `openssl`/`curl` directly against the Vercel IP (bypassing local DNS cache) — confirmed a valid Let's Encrypt cert issued for `www.claritypledge.com`. Then set apex (`claritypledge.com`) as canonical: added two host-matched entries to `vercel.json`'s `redirects` array (mirroring the existing `understandingpledge.com` pattern) — `www.claritypledge.com` → `https://claritypledge.com` for both `/` and `/:path(.*)`, both `permanent: true` (308).

**Alternatives rejected:** Setting the primary-domain redirect via `vercel domains add --redirect` or `vercel redirects` — this CLI version (54.14.0) has no domain-level redirect flag and `vercel redirects` is path-based only, not host-based. Driving the Vercel dashboard via browser automation to set it — user chose the `vercel.json` approach instead since the codebase already had a working host-redirect pattern to copy.

**Consequences:** The `vercel.json` edit is inert until deployed to production — a deploy is still needed to activate the `www → apex` redirect (gated on explicit user deploy approval, not yet given as of this entry). `www` itself already serves correctly with a valid cert regardless of the redirect's deploy status, so the customer-facing bug is already fixed independent of this remaining step.

## 2026-07-08 [technical]: linkify.ts Safari<16.4 lookbehind removal — greedy char class means the lookbehind was only load-bearing for adjacent-match gluing, not isolated word-prefixes

**Context:** P983 (Sentry JAVASCRIPT-REACT-27) — `URL_PATTERN` in `linkify.ts` used a negative lookbehind `(?<!\w)` to avoid auto-linking bare domains glued to a preceding word character. Safari added regex lookbehind support only in 16.4; `new RegExp(...)` throws `SyntaxError` at construction on older Safari/iOS, crashing every component using `linkifyText` (~10 consumers). The original P983 bug spec's Fix Approach assumed the lookbehind blocked cases like `"xfoo.com"` (a bare domain with an immediately-preceding word char, no separator) — this was wrong and only caught during implementation via a direct regex trace (`node -e`). Because `[\w-]+\.(?:tld)` is greedy, the regex engine always absorbs any preceding word-char run into the match itself at its own start position — `"xfoo.com"` matches as one token starting at index 0 both with and without the lookbehind. The lookbehind was only ever load-bearing for a **second match starting immediately after a prior match's end with no gap** (e.g. `"example.combar.com"` → without the lookbehind, `"example.com"` and `"bar.com"` both match as separate links; with it, only the first does, since the char right before `"bar.com"`'s start is `example.com`'s trailing `m`).

**Decision:** Removed the lookbehind from the regex; replicated the *actual* semantics (skip a second match glued to a prior match's word-char tail) as an explicit branch in the match loop, using `start > 0 && /\w/.test(text[start-1] ?? '')` gated to bare-domain matches only (full `http(s)://` URLs stay exempt). Also caught and fixed an off-by-one in that new branch's push guard, copied from an existing sibling branch (`if (start > lastIndex)` — fails to push when `start === lastIndex`, i.e. exactly the zero-gap case this branch exists to handle; corrected to `if (start + url.length > lastIndex)`). The identical pre-existing bug in the sibling dangerous-scheme skip branch (unrelated to this fix, same file) was deliberately left alone and filed as P984 rather than expanding the diff.

**Alternatives rejected:** Trusting the bug spec's Fix Approach at face value and writing a test for `"xfoo.com"` in isolation — this test would have passed even on the broken pre-fix code (both regex variants linkify it identically), producing a canary that proves nothing. Caught only by manually tracing the regex with `node -e` before committing to the test.

**Consequences:** When replacing a lookbehind/lookahead assertion with equivalent loop logic for engine-compat reasons, verify the assertion's *actual* effect with a standalone regex trace (`node -e` against both variants on varied inputs) before writing the replacement — don't infer the semantics from the assertion's apparent English meaning. A negative lookbehind on a greedy preceding character class is often only load-bearing at match *boundaries* (post-previous-match), not at arbitrary "word before domain" positions, because the engine already swallows any qualifying prefix into the match itself.

## 2026-07-08 [product]: First-cohort group flip priced €99 (founding discount off a €500 shown price); the €99 payment is a commitment probe, not a value read — value is read upstream in the interview (UNTESTED)

**Context:** A pricing conversation off the back of the /claude-conversations-to-cp run. The offer structure was confirmed as **flip-in-a-group** now, with the **clarity practice community** opening later once enough people have been flipped (matches goals.md rungs 3→4 — this is not offer inflation, it's the existing ladder). Two things needed settling: what /pmf shows vs what the first cohort pays, and what the €99 payment actually tells us. Founder pushed back on two of my claims mid-session (recorded because the prior reasoning would mislead a future session): (1) that offer-inflation was the problem — it wasn't; the group format is intentional, the real failure was the offer not being *frozen* before the meeting; (2) that a €99 payment reads *value* — it does not.

**Decision (all UNTESTED, `[FOUNDER DECISION: pricing]`):**
- **First cohort = €99**, held as a deliberate **founding-cohort discount off a €500 shown price** on /pmf. €99 lowers friction to fill the first room, which is the point — the deliverable is a validated/killed H-FounderWince, not revenue. €500 is the price to *raise into* once proof/testimonials exist (early-cohort-lower-rises-with-brand, same pattern as the therapist cert and the dormant cofounder funnel).
- **Show €500, discount to €99 with a stated reason** (founding members, limited spots, price rises after) — a bare €500→€99 with no reason reads as desperation or a fake anchor. €500 must be a price genuinely intended later, or the anchor is dishonest. Same principle as the dormant cofounder funnel (2026-06-15 / line ~1242: public shows regular, founding price is the close) — now applied to the **active** founder-direct /pmf funnel.
- **The €99 payment is a commitment/friction probe, not a value read.** It tells you €99 wasn't a blocker — nothing about the value ceiling. **Value is read upstream, in the interview**, where the founder names what the comprehension gap has *cost* them (H-WTP-Pain: value follows a named, felt cost), and midstream, in the **pull after the flip** (do they reach for more unprompted). Don't misread a paid cohort as value-proof.
- **Freeze the offer before any conversion meeting.** The 2026-07-08 coaching-consultation-prep conversation redesigned the offer live across ~8 iterations (audit → flip → four sessions → group + badging → …). The fix is one frozen sentence — what, how long, how much, guarantee — set *before* the meeting; if a parameter moves in the room, it wasn't frozen. (Founder-behavior/survival-pressure aspects of that conversation are private → pp, not recorded here.)

**Alternatives rejected:** €300 group flip for cohort 1 (goals.md candidate) — higher friction to fill the first validation room; €300 kept as a later raise target, not the founding price. Discounting *live in the room* from a higher number — destroys the WTP data; the founding discount must be pre-set and held, not a nervous concession.

**Consequences:** goals.md already carries ~$99 for the first PoC group (2026-07-04) — this entry adds the **€500-shown-anchor** and the **value-is-read-in-the-interview** clarification, both currently absent from goals.md. The **$99 PoC offer page (/pmf)** — already flagged as an in-progress goals.md artifact — should show €500 with an explicit founding discount to €99. No strategy-doc (lean-canvas/hypotheses) edit needed: lean-canvas §Revenue already says "~$99 diagnostic" and H-WTP-Pain already frames value as following a named cost. The next physical action is unchanged: run founder interviews, fill one €99 room of 4.

**References:** goals.md §Active (rung ladder, rungs 3–4) · hypotheses.md H-WTP-Pain (value follows named cost) + H-FounderWince · lean-canvas.md §Revenue (~$99 diagnostic) · decisions.md 2026-06-15 [product] (public-regular / founding-close price split — dormant cofounder funnel) · 2026-07-04 [product] (~$99 PoC group confirmed).

## 2026-07-07 [product]: Discovery-by-asking retired for the audit-demo; will-lever mechanism (low will ← believed-high skill); audit the capacity, not the model (all UNTESTED)

**Context:** First founder interview under the 2026-07-04 wedge (interview #1 — architecture owner of two AI-agent projects; **not** the what-to-build/for-whom owner). The felt impression was "one hour lost, no wince." The **transcript** (`.private/docs/business/customer-dev-lessons.md` 2026-07-07, source recording in `.private/`) contradicted it: he named a sharp, on-domain challenge (shared-clarity degradation in AI-first teams) *confidently* and volunteered CP's illusion thesis unprompted ("we agreed table… but it has shit on it… both of you have clarity… but specificity is lost"). Meta-lesson: **score interviews from the transcript, not the vibe.** The call failed not on a weak wince but on (a) wrong-owner sampling, (b) no conversion to a costed ask/demo, (c) role-drift (interviewee coached the interviewer). This surfaced the model refinements below.

**Decision (all UNTESTED, refine H-FounderWince):**
- **Will-lever mechanism (foundational):** low will to reveal understanding gaps is *caused by* believed-high skill ("I already understand"). So the only thing that moves will is a **live disconfirmation** of that belief — you cannot argue someone into wanting clarity they think they already have. This is the causal "why" under the canvas's existing "will problem, not a skill problem" (lean-canvas §Problem) and connects to definitions §self-sealing illusion + H-WTP-Pain 2026-06-18 ("need it most, report it least").
- **Discovery-by-asking is retired for the audit-demo.** Self-report cannot surface the illusion — the wince is invisible to the person who has it, so asking "are you unsure?" surfaces only *conscious* uncertainty. The pre-interview gate keeps ONE job (screen role + a live stakes-bearing relationship) and loses the other (detecting the wince). Only an audit that *reveals* the gap can. The demo (reveal → bridge) is simultaneously the validation and the sale.
- **Audit the CAPACITY to detect understanding gaps, not their business model.** Auditing model-understanding is contestable (I lack authority over their business); auditing *mutual* understanding between two people is self-evident (one rates 8/10, paraphrases, gets it wrong — the delta IS the illusion, needing no authority from me). **Solo-founder fix:** put several founders in a room and audit whether they can spot gaps *with each other*, betting **peer-gap-spotting predicts customer-gap-spotting** (UNTESTED — the bridge to the money domain).
- **Positioning bet — the status flip:** revealing an understanding gap today is a *status loss* (asking to paraphrase looks slow/weak); CP flips it to a *status gain*. Not new — it is the antinorm already in definitions §self-sealing illusion + H-NormFlip, now named as the sell. Candidate P982 line ("Turn revealing an understanding gap from status loss into status gain") remains `[FOUNDER DECISION]` (copy).
- **Criteria sharpened:** interview target = **owner of what-to-build + for-whom** (screen: "Whose call is it what you build next and who it's for?"). Refines the H-FounderWince ICP qualifier; the interviewee is the wrong owner *for the customer wedge*.
- **Fatalism objection (mechanism risk):** the interviewee felt the shared-clarity pain acutely but believes AI makes it *unsolvable* — a distinct objection from "we're fine." The **bridge must beat fatalism**, not just reveal a gap; a reveal without a credible close hands a fatalist more evidence to give up.
- **ICP-bifurcation (watch-item, n=1):** two owners surfaced — *product-direction owner* (customer understanding = the wedge) vs *team lead* (internal shared meaning). The interviewee is a live datapoint that the team-internal version has articulate, unprompted pull. **Do not move the wedge on n=1** — re-cut only if a 2nd/3rd builder volunteers the team-internal pain the same way.

**Falsifier:** if audit-and-bridge on a real stakes-bearing understanding gap does NOT raise will (shrug / rationalize / defensive disengage), the will-lever is wrong or reactance/fatalism dominates → revert to a different activation path. If peer-gap-spotting does not predict customer-gap-spotting, the solo-in-a-room premise fails. **Do not scale-sell before the demo is proven to fire** (cold-message-at-scale + money-back before ~5–10 warm live demos land = premature scaling).

**Consequences:** applied to hypotheses.md H-FounderWince (new 2026-07-07 refinement block + summary-row evidence). Interview method fixes ("most unsure about" over "biggest challenge"; loss/gain baseline question; a pre-interview scoping sheet — the one the interviewee himself prescribed) route to `.private/docs/business/discovery-questions.md` + customer-dev-lessons.md (tactical, not strategy-doc). Status-flip copy + any lean-canvas UVP positioning line remain `[FOUNDER DECISION]`.

**References:** hypotheses.md H-FounderWince · decisions.md 2026-07-04 [product] (domain sharpening) · 2026-06-18 (don't-qualify-on-self-reported-need) · lean-canvas.md §Problem (will-primacy) + §self-sealing illusion · H-NormFlip · `.private/docs/business/customer-dev-lessons.md` 2026-07-07.

## 2026-07-04 [product]: Founder wedge sharpened — "get to PMF faster" via customer-development clarity; the illusion of understanding IS customer-dev's central failure mode (UNTESTED)

**Context:** A think-first session (no interviews — derived beforehand to point the 3 scheduled founder interviews, and to change how they're run *before* not after) sharpened H-FounderWince from "clarity on anything" to a domain, a market, and a competitive set. Trigger: the retention critique — targeting a *will-problem* is a bad retention engine (solve it → they leave; someone with will → "disqualified"). Resolved by moving the sold object from the meta-skill to a **recurring domain problem**.

**Decision (all UNTESTED, to be validated/falsified by the 3 interviews):**
- **Lead with the outcome: "Get to PMF faster."** The practice community is the *how*, not the headline.
- **Central positioning BET:** the **illusion of recursive understanding is customer development's central failure mode** — founders hear what they want to hear and believe they understood the customer when they didn't (The Mom Test's whole thesis). CP attacks this directly, so it is not a generic clarity tool bolted onto customer dev — it targets customer dev's core failure. *We do not KNOW this is the central failure — it is a strong, canon-supported claim, recorded as the positioning bet, not asserted as fact.*
- **Founder's value-prop one-liner:** "Get to PMF faster by increasing your will/skill/commitment to reveal gaps in understanding of your customers and prove it to them, and by bridging your own understanding gaps of your main problem statement." "Prove it to them" mechanic = ask the customer how well they felt understood after you paraphrase back (untested claim — most customer dev is extractive; this both verifies and builds the relationship).
- **Domain + community shape:** recurring domain = **customer-development / problem-validation clarity** for **pre-PMF founders & AI builders**. The community is the **upstream** peer room on a **cost-ascending clarity ladder (AI → peers/advisors → customers)** — build the verified-understanding muscle on peers (cheap) before expensive customer cycles; customer dev is the downstream payoff, not necessarily the in-room activity. It's a **practice / calibration-gym** (no graduation → retention), not an academy. **Guard (founder's known over-clarify pattern):** the community must carry a **stop-rule that ejects members toward customers** (accountability-pairing) so it doesn't become a place to intellectualize forever — armchair sharpens the *question*, only customers answer certain questions.
- **Object of understanding is layered:** (a) the founder's **own** problem statement / lean-canvas / critical assumptions AND (b) the **customer**. The construct applies to both.
- **Disqualifier correction (load-bearing):** do NOT disqualify a founder who "believes he has no gaps in understanding his customers" — that belief is the *signature of the illusion* (2026-06-18: those who need it most self-report needing it least), often the best prospect. Disqualify on **no openness + no live uncertain bet + a stable, understood business**, never on self-assessed gap-absence.

**Qualification gate (pre-interview, so calls aren't spent disqualifying):** one screen question — "What are you most unsure about in your business right now?" — qualifies on a what-to-build / who-it's-for / will-this-sell uncertainty; soft/no on pure execution or funding.

**Competitive set (naming it is the discipline — if we can't list competitors we're not doing well):** YC Startup School / "talk to users", The Mom Test (Rob Fitzpatrick), Teresa Torres continuous-discovery, founder masterminds, cohort courses (On Deck-style), indie-hacker communities, accelerators, AI-cofounder tools. CP differentiator: attacks the *self-fooling* failure mode with verified understanding, practiced in a stage-matched peer room.

**Alternatives rejected:** sell the will-problem as the product (retention-hostile — solving it ends the need; a founder *with* will is your best customer, not disqualified — will is the entry gate, the recurring domain is the retention engine); "clarity on anything" (illegible, churny, needs huge top-of-funnel; can't name a market or competitors); community-as-academy (graduation kills retention); anonymous batch-voting on membership (social-dynamics risk — parked; the "fractional co-founders" *framing* kept); formal skill-level pre-grading for the PoC group (rough stage-compatibility suffices — experienced founders are often worse listeners, so the skill isn't redundant for them).

**Falsifier:** if the 3 interviews show founders' felt pull is on **execution / funding / loneliness** rather than customer/problem clarity, OR **customer development is not the domain that pulls**, the positioning is wrong (re-cut the domain). If "prove it to the customer" produces no relational/verification lift when tried, drop that clause. Folds into H-FounderWince's discovery test.

**Consequences:** applied additively (UNTESTED) to lean-canvas §UVP + §Customer Segments + §Current Alternatives + §Revenue-adjacent, and hypotheses.md H-FounderWince, via `/slava:maintain:docs-strategy-update`. Interview artifacts: `discovery-questions.md` updated (pre-interview qualifier, frame-set, layered object, customer-evidence probe); the **written offer / landing** is the remaining artifact (needs [FOUNDER DECISION] on price, community name, first-PoC format) — spec via `/create-spec`. Name/price/copy remain [FOUNDER DECISION].

**References:** hypotheses.md H-FounderWince · lean-canvas §UVP + §Customer Segments (Active focus) · decisions.md 2026-07-01 [product] (wedge + will-root) · 2026-07-02 [product] (retention loop) · 2026-06-18 (don't-qualify-on-self-reported-need) · `.private/docs/business/discovery-questions.md` (founder section) · `.private/docs/business/solopreneur-wedge-parking-lot.md`.

## 2026-07-03 [product]: Early-adopter definition (structural skill/will/environment deficit) + three criteria re-derived as a challenge-filter

**Context:** Two 2026-07 conversations stress-testing CP's frameworks against a smart skeptic re-derived the "three early-adopter criteria" from first principles and sharpened who the wedge audience is. The criteria (2026-04-23) had drifted session-to-session ("compounding duration" vs "delayed feedback"; "concentrated consequences" vs "concentrated stakes" vs "high consequences") because they floated free of a derivation. Surfaced via `/claude-conversations-to-cp` (founder markers "document properly" + "file a slide listing criteria").

**Decision:**
- **Early-adopter = a founder / high-level decision-maker who builds with AI** (the individual-founder unit — see definitions.md "Founder (ICP)") whose problem is a **structural lack of the skill, will, or committed social environment** to **predictably achieve clarity on important challenges** — a structural deficit, not a one-off gap. Maps onto what CP supplies: skill (verify), will (reveal your own gaps when values clash — 5-move Move 1 / H-AffectiveHonesty), and a social environment committed to clarity (a room/peer vs a solo builder's AI that only agrees).
- **The three criteria filter the *challenge*, not the person/dyad, pinned to a derivation:** a challenge is worth the instrument when its natural consequence-arbiter *fails* — and there are exactly three failure modes: **fuzzy intent** (too ambiguous to arbitrate), **delayed feedback** (too late to arbitrate), **concentrated stakes** (too costly to arbitrate by trial). Meaning hardens into fact via repeated shared consequence; these three are where that arbiter breaks. Supersedes the 2026-04-23 dyad-filter wording ("compounding duration" named the *damage*, not the filter); the dormant cofounder block keeps a pointer, not a rewrite (reversal-lock safe).

**Falsifier:** if founders whose challenges sit outside all three criteria pull on the instrument just as hard as those inside, the criteria don't filter and the targeting is noise (folds into H-FounderWince's discovery test). If the pinned terms drift again next session, the derivation didn't hold.

**Applied via `/slava:maintain:docs-strategy-update`:** lean-canvas §Customer Segments (active "Founders / solo AI builders" block — two additive bullets; dormant "Co-Founder Pairs" 2026-04-23 block — one pointer line). Content captured in a29 (min) enrichment + a46 (claim-splitter — the mechanistic grounding). Feature notes (splitter tool, which-world lead-magnet, criteria slide) tracked separately, not in strategy docs.

## 2026-07-03 [process]: /day Sentry+Mixpanel checks — per-server OAuth self-heal + mandatory loud status lines

**Context:** Founder noticed `/day` "seems not to" check Sentry/Mixpanel. Both are wired in, but each had a silent-skip path that read as healthy: Sentry had no self-heal (just "check manually"), and Mixpanel's quiet-day skip (no real users → never called) looked identical to a connection failure. Verified the mechanism live: both use the same `mcp-remote` OAuth cache in `~/.mcp-auth/`, and found active drift — `.mcp.json` pins `mcp-remote@0.1.37` but Sentry's cached token sits under the `0.1.36` dir (a latent silent-auth break).

**Decision:** (1) Sentry gets the same auto self-heal Mixpanel already had — on MCP-down, read the mcp-log, and on stale-OAuth clear the token and retry. (2) Clears are **per-server hash-globs, not nuke-all**: Sentry = `~/.mcp-auth/mcp-remote-*/305d49f5*` (`md5('https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp')`), Mixpanel = `.../3065cf*`. Verified disjoint (dry-run listing) — clearing one never logs you out of the other; the glob spans all version dirs so it survives the pin drifting. (3) Both checks MUST emit exactly one explicit status line, where a `SKIPPED (failed)` is visually distinct from `clean`, and Mixpanel's `not called (no real users)` is distinct from `SKIPPED (failed)`. HEALTH block now lists both.

**Alternatives rejected:** nuke-all `rm -rf ~/.mcp-auth/mcp-remote-*/` (the earlier manual 403/scope-stale fix in this log) — correct for an interactive one-off re-auth, wrong for an automated per-check self-heal because it logs you out of every mcp-remote server to fix one. External GitHub-issue alerting (P866 pattern) — `/day` is always interactive, so a loud line IS the alert; there's no unattended gap to cover. Adversarial-review/`/falsify` — reserved for prod code/infra/process rules; a skill-doc change with one verified-safe `rm` glob doesn't warrant it.

**Consequences:** Sentry self-heal is **unproven until observed failing** — MCP was healthy this session so the failure path couldn't be triggered (per epistemic gate #7, a gate unseen-failing is unproven). Watch the next real stale-auth. The version drift (token under 0.1.36, pin 0.1.37) is absorbed by the version-spanning glob but not fixed at root; if it recurs, reconcile the pin.

**References:** `.claude/commands/slava/day.md` Wave 2a (Sentry) + Wave 2b (Mixpanel) · earlier decisions.md `mcp-remote` 403/scope-stale entry (nuke-all manual fix this refines) · `.claude/rules/epistemic.md` gate #7.

## 2026-07-03 [product]: Posture 2 (individual founder, founder-direct batch-close) supersedes Posture 1 (co-founder-pair, coach-first)

**Context:** The 2026-07-01 pivot flipped the strategy docs' near-term *market* to individual founders (H-SolopreneurWince) but left ~6 "coaches are the primary channel / founders are the proof, not the acquisition surface" sections in lean-canvas + theory-of-change, plus the whole of goals.md and the `.private` GTM worksheet, still on the old co-founder-pair / coach-first posture. Two live postures contradicted each other across the docs — the unreconciled split that fed the recurring founder-vs-agent argument (see 2026-07-03 [process] reconciliation).

**Decision:** **Posture 2 supersedes Posture 1 as the active near-term GTM.**
- **Posture 2 (active):** the **individual founder** runs a **founder-direct batch-close** funnel (approach → 1:1 diagnostic → Clarity Letter → async peer exchange → group meeting → offer reveal + deadline). No coach intermediary; the founder is the acquisition surface.
- **Term = "founder," not "solopreneur."** The ICP is the **individual founder as the single-person-funnel unit, with or without a co-founder** — partner-existence is a *parameter*, not a disqualifier. This is distinct from the **co-founder-PAIR unit** (two-sided coordination), which is now **dormant, not deleted**. The Problem foregrounds the **intrapersonal will-primary root already established 2026-07-01** — *you won't reveal your own gaps even when you could* — which holds with or without a co-founder (a co-founder often shares the blind spot, or the hard conversation is avoided; the community, not the co-founder, is the stress-test). This is what makes "founder (partner = a parameter)" coherent rather than collapsing back into the pair target.
- **Rename the hypothesis ID:** `H-SolopreneurWince` → **`H-FounderWince`** across the living strategy docs (append-only decisions history keeps the old ID; an alias line bridges it). Prose `solopreneur` → `founder` in living docs.
- **Active-on-top / dormant-below:** the coach channel (H-CoachChannel) and the co-founder-pair market are relabeled dormant-below, kept intact and revivable — nothing deleted. The **€950 co-founder-pair package stays dormant** in lean-canvas Revenue; the **$300 founder batch-close price** is the active tactical price in goals.md.

**Alternatives rejected:** keep "solopreneur" (implies *solo*, wrongly excludes founders who have a co-founder but still won't reveal their own gaps); delete the coach-first / pair content (loses the revivable fallback — this is a market-focus relabel, not a construct reversal); collapse €950 and $300 into one price home (they are two postures' prices — €950 dormant-pair-structural, $300 active-founder-tactical).

**Consequences:** Encoded via the doc-charter (below): posture flip lands active-on-top/dormant-below across lean-canvas + theory-of-change; goals.md moves Posture-1 content to a Superseded section and writes the Posture-2 batch-close funnel; the `.private` worksheet slims to named residue. Batch-close funnel *mechanics* + $300 price + refund policy live in goals.md (tactical); the *bet* lives in hypotheses.md (H-FounderWince).

**Falsifier:** this decision IS the execution frame for **H-FounderWince** — if batch-1 (~10 founder-direct diagnostics) produces no wince + pull + pay, the founder-direct posture is falsified and Posture 1 (coach-first, co-founder-pair) revives from dormant. Term-level falsifier: if the diagnostics show the wince only fires for *paired* founders (partner is NOT just a parameter), the "individual founder" ICP re-splits.

**References:** decisions.md 2026-07-01 [product] (market-focus shift + will-primary root) · 2026-07-03 [product] (batch-close design, charge-timing, sub-bets) · hypotheses.md H-FounderWince · docs/CHARTER.md · goals.md.

## 2026-07-03 [process]: Doc separation-of-duties charter (docs/CHARTER.md) — one home per fact, pointers everywhere else

**Context:** The same fact lives in several docs (R₀≈0 in 6 places, coach-fit ICP in 3, the €950 price + 25% code scattered). A strategic pivot updated some copies and left others stale — the drift that made the 2026-07-01 posture split possible and fed the recurring routing argument (2026-07-03 [process] reconciliation). There was no written rule for *which doc owns which kind of fact*, so every agent re-derived it.

**Decision:** Adopt a **doc separation-of-duties charter** at **`docs/CHARTER.md`** — a first-match-wins routing decision tree assigning every kind of info exactly ONE home (identifying → `.private`; definition → definitions.md; dated why+falsifier → decisions.md; falsifiable bet → hypotheses.md; durable structural model → lean-canvas.md; durable impact mechanism → theory-of-change.md; tactical GTM/funnel → goals.md; auto-metric → progress.md AUTO block; deferred idea → `.private` parking-lot). Everyone else points to the one home; no copies. The charter is the single source of the tree; each doc carries a one-line `Charter:` header pointing to CHARTER.md. The four structural-vs-tactical tension pairs (lean-canvas channel-BET vs goals channel-MECHANICS, etc.) are resolved by the "Tuesday experiment rewrites it → tactical; changing it is a pivot → structural" test (2026-07-03 [process]).

**Alternatives rejected:** inline the 9-way tree in this log (append-only would freeze a copy that drifts — the exact failure the charter fights — so this entry records only *adopt-a-charter + pointer*, never the tree itself); put the charter in README.md (README conventionally = folder index, GitHub auto-renders it — reserve it); restate the tree in the docs-strategy-update skill (the skill *references* CHARTER.md, keeps only its strategy-doc-specific routing rule).

**Consequences:** `docs/CHARTER.md` created; `Charter:` header added to the 7 public strategy docs; docs-strategy-update Step 2 + CLAUDE.md "Source of truth docs" gain a one-line pointer to CHARTER.md (CLAUDE.md via the claude-md gate). De-dup pass folds the scattered copies to one-home-plus-pointer.

**Falsifier:** if a new fact lands and an agent cannot determine its single home from CHARTER.md's tree (two docs both plausibly claim it and the tie-break test doesn't resolve it), the charter is under-specified — extend the tree, don't let a second copy grow.

**References:** decisions.md 2026-07-03 [process] (routing-axis reconciliation, the tie-break test) · docs/CHARTER.md · `.claude/commands/slava/maintain/docs-strategy-update/SKILL.md` Step 2.

## 2026-07-03 [process]: Reconciled the strategy-doc routing rule onto the right axis (retires the "unvalidated/unrun" framing that kept recurring)

**Context:** For the 3rd+ time, an agent kept tactical content out of a strategy doc citing the 2026-06-18 "don't formalize unrun process" rule; the founder pushed back that "everything in lean-canvas/theory-of-change is an unvalidated bet, so 'keep unvalidated things out' is incoherent"; and the same argument got re-derived from scratch. Forensics: TWO rules on adjacent questions both sit live in the log on **opposite axes** — 2026-06-30 [process] fixed the *edit-permission* axis (destructive-vs-additive; "validation is not a precondition for recording") but never retired the 2026-06-18 *routing* rule, which is still stated on the dead epistemic axis (decisions.md ~"not formalized until the first session validates it"). An agent greps the log, grabs the 06-18 framing, and re-triggers the fight. A prior prevention flag (kdd-suppressed-log, "check decisions.md before quoting strategy docs as canonical") was EV-suppressed — which is how it reached "multiple times."

**Decision:** The strategy-doc rule has **two orthogonal dimensions; neither is about epistemic status; neither ever pre-blocks a write** (challenge voice, not veto — consistent with 2026-06-30):
- **Edit permission (may I change this box?):** destructive-vs-additive (2026-06-30). Additive, honestly-labeled (`UNTESTED`), falsifier-carrying content is always recordable. Validation is not a precondition.
- **Routing (which doc holds it?):** structural/durable vs tactical/volatile — NOT validated-vs-unvalidated. The structural bet (customer, value-prop, mechanism, and the channel *bet* of *who delivers* — e.g. coaches; *change = pivot*) lives in lean-canvas/theory-of-change; tactical mechanics (funnel choreography, prices, per-step targets, event run-of-show — including channel *mechanics* like a webinar format; *change = every experiment*) live in decisions.md/goals.md/.private. The reason is **churn-isolation** (volatile tactics would rewrite the durable model constantly), not epistemic rank — everything in the strategy docs is an unvalidated bet too. Routing is **advisory and never withholds content**: default is to record it (with a falsifier + honest `UNTESTED` label — that requirement is the churn/scope brake, so "record freely" ≠ "dump anything"); the agent may recommend *which doc*; the founder decides; nothing is blocked. If a piece is genuinely ambiguous, record it where the founder wants — do not argue placement (that argument IS the recurrence).

**Retires:** the 2026-06-18 "don't formalize unrun process" framing and its restatements (06-19, 06-22, coach-fit entries) **as stated on the epistemic axis**. Their surviving content is the routing dimension above, restated on the structural-vs-tactical axis. Append-only: those entries stay as history, superseded-not-deleted.

**Canonical home (kills the duplication — the recurrence fuel):** the rule now lives in ONE place, `/slava:maintain:docs-strategy-update` Step 2. decisions.md entries and hypotheses.md glosses reference it by pointer; no entry restates it. (Reference-Over-Duplication applied to the rule itself — the ~7 scattered, drifting restatements were what let an agent grab a stale copy.)

**Tripwire (point-of-use):** the skill carries a bold STOP note — if an agent is excluding content from a strategy doc because it is "unvalidated/unrun," that axis is retired; the only questions are destructive-vs-additive and structural-vs-tactical; recording is never blocked.

**Falsifier:** if, after this, an agent again excludes strategy-doc content on **any** grounds the founder experiences as a block — epistemic-status OR structural (a routing *recommendation to exclude* counts if it reads to the founder as a refusal to record) — or the founder again has to re-derive the axis, the reconciliation failed. Remedy is then the deferred mechanical gate (below), not more prose.

**Deferred hardening (offered, not built this turn — honest about the trade):** a pre-commit *detection* gate that greps a staged decisions.md/strategy-doc diff for dead-axis exclusion phrasing ("until validated", "don't formalize", "unrun … out of") and WARNs (never blocks — a block would violate never-pre-block). Not built now because a gate must be *seen to fail* before it's trusted (epistemic gate 7) — that's its own task. The inline supersession stamps added this session already convert every EXISTING dead-axis log hit into a forward-pointer, so the residual risk the gate would cover is only a FUTURE new dead-axis restatement. Adversarial review flagged that deferring the mechanism repeats 06-30's pattern; the stamps are the mitigation that makes deferral defensible, not free.

**Alternatives rejected:** a 7th prose restatement (proven to fail — that IS the recurrence); deleting the routing rule entirely (loses churn-isolation — the durable model would then hold volatile funnels, and a real pivot becomes indistinguishable from a Tuesday tweak); a hard pre-block on tactical-in-strategy-doc (violates "never pre-block a write," 2026-06-30).

**Consequences:** Skill edit applied (Step 2 axis-preamble + STOP tripwire) — approved by founder this session. Skill changes are normally `/falsify`-gated per CLAUDE.md; an adversarial-review pass was run this session in lieu (verdict recorded in-session). My own contribution to the recurrence: the reconciling entry (06-30) was in the same file I grepped, and I cited the older 06-18 framing anyway — behavioral fix is to grep for the newest reconciling entry before citing an older rule.

**References:** decisions.md 2026-06-30 [process] (edit-permission axis) · 2026-06-18 / 06-19 / 06-22 (retired routing framing) · `.claude/commands/slava/maintain/docs-strategy-update/SKILL.md` Step 2 · `~/.claude/kdd-suppressed-log.md` (prior suppressed flag).

## 2026-07-03 [product]: Two new solopreneur sub-bets (transferability, funnel-repeatability) + batch-close validation design + charge-timing

**Context:** Session designing the post-interview path for the solopreneur wedge (H-SolopreneurWince). Two risks the wedge hypothesis had been silently fusing got separated, and a concrete launch shape (batch close) crystallized. Per the strategy-doc routing rule (reconciled 2026-07-03 [process] — structural bets → scoreboard, tactical funnel mechanics → here, for churn-isolation not epistemic status), the *falsifiable bets* go to hypotheses.md; the *funnel mechanics* stay here.

**Decision:**
- **Separate the fused risks into two named sub-bets** (added to hypotheses.md under H-SolopreneurWince):
  - **H-ProtocolTransfers (possibly the *primary* risk):** clarity production transfers *off the founder* — peers produce a clarity shift in each other via the protocol with the founder absent. The founder can already produce clarity 1:1; whether the *product* lets peers replicate it is unproven, and it — not WTP — decides scalable-product vs founder-delivered-consulting (the 5-hours-per-person ceiling that killed the pair model).
  - **H-FunnelRepeatability (DEFERRED, phase-2):** qualified members can be sourced repeatably at viable cost without a one-time warm channel. A first accelerator-sourced batch proves demand + delivery, NOT acquisition.
- **The WTP-vs-transferability distinction (the load-bearing insight):** closing a batch where the founder ran the letters and orchestrated the exchange proves **WTP only** (H-SolopreneurWince). Transferability (H-ProtocolTransfers) is read **in the 3-month delivery**, not at the close — so the delivery must be *designed* to test it (by ~month 3: does at least one member pair produce a clarity shift with zero founder involvement?), or three months are spent learning nothing about the primary risk.
- **Batch-close validation experiment (unrun — recorded here, not in the scoreboard):** ~20 free 1:1 clarity sessions (warm intros) → a Clarity Letter per person → one async peer exchange (each answers another's letter) → **one group meeting of all ~20** (each knows ~5, doesn't know ~15) where they experience peer clarity, *then* the offer is revealed with a decision deadline. Target read: 5-10 of 20 close = WTP validated; 0-1 = offer/ICP wrong. The group meeting is also the H-ProtocolTransfers demo (peer-produced clarity felt before the ask). CAC is NOT tested (the batch was sourced free, once) and the founder's hours are the uncounted cost — the $-figure is not the win, the two reads are.
- **Charge-timing (recommended, [FOUNDER DECISION] on price):** free through the whole demo (interview → letter → peer exchange → group meeting); reveal offer + price **at the group meeting**, charge **then**, urgency from the decision deadline (not pre-payment); only money-back = **refund-on-fail** (they don't pass the gate: 9 stories + CK letter + sign community agreement). Do NOT reveal price at the 1:1 (front-loads the sale, pollutes discovery). Rejected: charge-after-interview-refund-if-not-proceed (front-loads a transaction before peer value felt, weaker signal); deposit-then-balance (adds a state + balance-chase failure mode).

**Alternatives rejected:** putting the batch funnel / prices ($300, 20, 5-10) into hypotheses.md or lean-canvas (tactical mechanics churn the durable model — a routing call, not a validation bar; see 2026-07-03 [process]); a second 1:1 as the return step (replaced by the all-interviewees group meeting — the peer-replication test); "do it again" / "intro me" as WTP signals (founder correctly diagnosed both as too cheap to test willingness-to-pay).

**Falsifier:** (transferability) if by ~month-3 delivery no member pair produces a clarity shift with zero founder involvement → reverts to founder-delivered consulting. (funnel) if batch-2 sourcing without a warm channel can't fill a qualified cohort at sustainable cost → PLG premise fails, model caps at founder-hustled cohorts. (charge-timing) if revealing the offer only at the group meeting produces near-zero close while a pre-committed variant closes materially better → the free-until-the-offer sequence is wrong.

**Consequences:** Tiering-by-salary, the exact price, and refund terms are downstream [FOUNDER DECISION]s parked until batch-1's two reads (WTP + transferability) come back. Batch-close funnel detail belongs in `.private/docs/business/solopreneur-wedge-parking-lot.md` if expanded.

**Applied via `/slava:maintain:docs-strategy-update`:** hypotheses.md (H-SolopreneurWince — two sub-bet blocks added). p567 curriculum gained the 9-question surfacing set (separate spec edit, not a strategy doc).

## 2026-07-02 [product]: Clarity-achieved definition + named retention loop (clarity→will→action→new-gaps)

**Context:** Session refining the solopreneur-wedge 1:1 diagnostic surfaced two capture-worthy items. We had many "Clarity X" entity definitions but none for *when clarity is achieved*; and the retention mechanism behind the ~$99/mo sustaining bet was implied ("evolving bets keep the need recurring") but never stated as an explicit loop.

**Decision:**
- **Clarity (achieved) = tested-ness, not certainty.** A problem statement has enough clarity when its author has verified understanding of the strongest counterarguments to it and it survived — "enough" scaling with **stakes** (bigger downside/upside of a wrong problem statement ⇒ stronger counterarguments required). Never "the right answer" (fallibilist). Doubles as the **stop-rule**: stop seeking more clarity when counterargument strength met is proportional to stakes.
- **Retention loop (named mechanism, UNTESTED):** clarity → will → action → new gaps → clarity. Action on a clarified problem statement generates new gaps, reopening the need — the recurring-need mechanism behind H-SolopreneurWince's ~$99/mo sustaining bet.

**Falsifier:** (clarity def) if practitioners reach durable clarity via intuition/agreement *without* meeting proportional counterarguments, the tested-ness definition is wrong. (loop) if rung-1-completing founders do NOT return with a new gap within a membership cycle, the loop doesn't drive retention and the sustaining bet fails.

**Applied via `/slava:maintain:docs-strategy-update`:** definitions.md (new "Problem-Statement Clarity (When Clarity Is Achieved)"); hypotheses.md (H-SolopreneurWince retention-loop mechanism note). Interview questions capturing both live in `.private/docs/business/discovery-questions.md` (solopreneur audience).

## 2026-07-01 [product]: Solopreneur wedge (under test) + validate-the-wince-before-build sequencing

**Context:** Explored monetizing the verification instrument. The recurring failure mode this session was scope explosion under uncertainty — three distinct business models proposed in three turns (coaching upsell → capability-training → equity accelerator), each bigger and further from a testable next step. Root correction: the reachability premise behind the cofounder-pair target is weak for this founder (no warm *pairs*; two-person funnels convert poorly — must convince one to convince the other). The founder's actual channel reaches **solopreneurs** (single-person funnel, growing segment).

**Decision:**
- **Wedge hypothesis (NOT yet validated):** target solopreneurs, not cofounder pairs — chosen on *reachability* + single-person conversion, not because only they need it. The capability is one thing (calibrated understanding + verified-before-you-challenge) at two frequencies: customer-development (frequent, the practice/entry door) and partner-selection (rare, high-stakes, the pay trigger).
- **Value-prop reframe:** not "you misread people" but **"you're betting your venture on a belief no one has stress-tested"** — a place where challenge is *safe because understanding is verified first* (disagreement after proven comprehension = signal; without it = noise you defend against). Differentiator vs. generic solopreneur communities (see CitizenCircle analysis, `.private/research/citizencircle/_ANALYSIS.md`): sharp epistemic mechanism, not belonging.
- **Sequencing — validate the wince before any build:** (1) 5 solopreneurs, manual, existing `/letter/ck` demo + a 15-min debrief — does a real wince land + create pull? (2) if yes, sell a paid cohort; (3) only then build to scale. **Do not build to test.**
- **Agent verification tech (P828/P949) = scaling tool, not a launch requirement.** Launch runs on the existing self-serve demo + founder facilitating a cohort. Pre-join verification *gate* dropped entirely (frontloads cost, solves a non-problem) — verification's job is the self-serve *demo* that creates demand, not screening.

**Alternatives rejected:** equity accelerator / fractional-cofounder marketplace / mentor-vetting (all reintroduce the two-sided coordination the founder is fleeing — parked with revisit-triggers in `.private/docs/business/solopreneur-wedge-parking-lot.md`); "learning capacity beats expertise" pitch claim (overclaim; kept the defensible version: verify your advisor understands *your* situation before taking advice); one-shot cohort pricing over recurring (CitizenCircle shows recurring + content-funnel is the sustainable shape — deferred).

**Consequences:** Next action is a 5-person manual test, no code. Scope-control mechanism (`solopreneur-wedge-parking-lot.md`) created to hold expansion ideas with explicit revisit conditions.

**Applied 2026-07-01 (evening session) via `/slava:maintain:docs-strategy-update`:** lean-canvas (top pointer + Problem + Customer Segments + Revenue + Market Size + Why Now), hypotheses (H-SolopreneurWince added as active P0; H-TherapistRetention → Parked/superseded-as-active), theory-of-change (near-term pointer) — all flipped therapist→solopreneur active-on-top; therapist **demoted-not-deleted** (revivable). Reasons for the therapist demotion: epistemic-trust-floor mismatch (market *defined by* low trust while the instrument *needs* trust above a floor), cash-poor/waitlisted buyer, technocratic wrapper repels the low-trust client, safety overhead, no warm reach.

**Root refinement (evening):** the wedge root is a **will** problem — *unwilling to reveal one's own gaps when values clash* (attached to the product; the truth might reject it) — not a skill/verify gap. Value-prop sequence = **unlock the will → build the muscle** (graduated by values-clash intensity: peers on far-off topics → own product → customers) **→ de-risk**. One root, two faces: peer-challenge misread as attack; customer-politeness misread as validation.

**Framing correction (founder, 2026-07-01):** the 06-29→07-01 therapist episode is **normal error-correction, NOT a mistake** — proposed, got pushback, proceeded anyway, learned fast, corrected. The reversal-lock gate limited the damage (nothing deleted; a relabel), but the label-whiplash is inherent to a healthy conjecture-refutation loop, not a defect to fix. "Effort-asymmetry as a falsification signal" was tested this session and **rejected as non-universal** (the effortless option — cofounder — was itself unvalidated); the real safeguard is *pushback before codifying*, which happened. Meta-reflection deferred to `/kdd`.

## 2026-07-01 [process]: /scriptify — de-model a skill's mechanical steps into a script + A/B twin; gates must RUN, not self-attest

**Context:** Several skills (`link-to-this-chat`, `shorten-url`, `claude-sync-download`) spend a model turn running what is really deterministic bash. We wanted a way to extract the mechanical parts into scripts without losing the slash-command surface or silently changing behavior.

**Decision:** Built `/slava:util:scriptify` (skill on main `1fea651f`). It classifies every step of a target skill into three buckets and extracts only the mechanical ones:
- **mechanical** → extracted to `scripts/generated/<name>.sh`
- **judgment** (NL decision, content gen, "wait-until-X" success heuristics) → stays inline
- **non-scriptable-io** → stays inline: MCP/browser/computer-use **AND** stateful/authed/network CLIs (`open`, `curl`, `gh`, `supabase`, `claude-sync`). Forcing authed CLIs inline prevents **auth-path divergence** — a bash `curl` rewrite of an MCP call hits prod with a different credential scope than the original, which is a rewrite masquerading as an extraction.

The twin is a hybrid wrapper: the `/command` stays identical, the model does only the irreducibly model-gated steps, the script does the deterministic tail. Original left untouched (`git hash-object` snapshot proves it) for A/B.

**Meta-lesson (the reusable one):** the adversarial review found the skill's own safety checklist was **self-attestation** — "model confirms no MCP call landed in the script" re-asks the same judgment that could already have failed. That is exactly the epistemic-gate-7 failure (green happy-path ≠ gate fires) the skill exists to respect, turned on itself. Fix: convert every self-check into a **command whose output is pasted** — escape-grep (auth/network tokens in the script), secret-grep (public repo), negative-arg run (must exit non-zero), and a `find -newer` side-effect check proving `DRY_RUN=1` suppressed writes. **General principle: a skill's safety gate should be a grep/exit-code the agent runs, never a checkbox it ticks.**

**Alternatives rejected:** pure scripts with no slash command (loses discoverability + routing); convert only 100%-mechanical skills (skips useful partial wins like `claude-sync-download`, where the browser click + Gmail poll stay inline but the download→sync tail extracts cleanly); trust the model to keep MCP calls inline by instruction alone (the self-attestation failure above).

**Consequences:** Reusable pattern for de-modeling skills. `claude-sync-download-script` twin is UNVERIFIED until a live A/B run against a real export (dry-run only proved plumbing). Known false positive: the pre-commit privacy scanner flags scriptify.md because the file *contains* a secret-detector grep pattern (`secret|password|token`) — the scanner matched the scanner; benign, no real identifier.

**References:** `.claude/commands/slava/util/scriptify.md`; `scripts/generated/claude-sync-download.sh`; `.claude/rules/epistemic.md` gate 7.

## 2026-06-30 [process]: Strategy-doc update rule — discriminator is destructive-vs-additive, NOT validated-vs-untested

**Context:** The same-day "don't rewrite boxes for an untested bet" rule conflated two different things — *empirically unvalidated* and *don't write it down*. That froze the lean canvas until empirical validation, which is wrong: the canvas is a **living model of current best thinking**, most strategy is deductively reasoned, empirics are expensive, and a stale canvas is useless. Founder flagged it: "the lean canvas is there to be updated… not everything needs empiric validation… no rules should prevent updates once gates passed."

**Decision:** Replace the over-broad rule. The correct discriminator for a strategy-doc box update is **destructive vs additive**, not validated vs untested:
- **Update any box freely with current best thinking** when (a) epistemic status is labeled honestly (`UNTESTED` / hypothesis), (b) it carries a falsifier (Gate 5), and (c) it does **not** delete a revivable dormant fallback. Empirical validation is **not** a precondition for recording a reasoned model.
- **The only thing still guarded** is *destruction of a revivable fallback* (e.g. overwriting the cofounder boxes such that Plan B must be rebuilt from git). Solve this with the **active-on-top / dormant-below pattern** already used for §Customer Segments — extend it to every box (Problem, Revenue, Market Size, etc.): active (labeled UNTESTED) on top, dormant version preserved below. Update fully AND keep the fallback.
- Disagreement is a **challenge voice** — raise it; do not pre-block the write.

**The label does the work:** "update freely" is safe only because the `UNTESTED` tag carries the epistemic weight (Gate 1 still forbids unlabeled status words / unsourced numbers). A reader must never mistake a deductively-reasoned box for a validated one.

**Falsifier:** if `UNTESTED`-labeled boxes start accumulating as unpruned bloat (Gate 4 net-bloat count climbs across syncs), **or** the label gets used to launder a high-stakes claim past scrutiny (a confident reframe tagged UNTESTED to skip challenge), **or** readers/agents can no longer tell believed-vs-validated content apart in a box — then the discriminator is too permissive and must re-tighten (e.g. require a challenge-voice sign-off for any box rewrite, not just additive labeling). *(Failure modes surfaced by the /falsify critique pass on this rule, 2026-06-30.)*

**Alternatives rejected:** keep the blanket "don't rewrite until validated" (freezes the doc, founder-rejected); "no gates at all" (loses anti-churn + honest-labeling protection — the baby in the bathwater); fix only Gate 1's scope wording instead of a standalone rule (the /falsify critique's preferred route — but falsification showed the real blocker was a *product-decision entry*, not Gate 1, so a Gate 1 scope edit would not have unblocked the write; the superseding rule is doing real work).

**Consequences:** Supersedes the reusable rule in 2026-06-30 [product] "Canvas representation…" ("relabel status + summarize box-deltas; don't rewrite boxes for an untested bet"). The therapist Problem/Revenue/Market-Size boxes are now updated in full (active-on-top/dormant-below). Propagate into the `/docs-strategy-update` skill gate language next — a skill edit (needs approval) and, per CLAUDE.md, a `/falsify` pass on this rule change before hardening it.

**References:** docs/lean-canvas.md §Problem, §Revenue, §Market Size; supersedes 2026-06-30 [product] "Canvas representation of the (untested) market-focus shift".

## 2026-06-30 [product]: Therapist value-model refinements — client receptivity gap, Arm A over Arm B, certification-as-revenue, TAM estimate, safety gap

**Context:** A session exploring how to convince skeptical therapists (epistemic-trust paper → rupture-repair literature → market scan → objection ledger at `.private/docs/business/stakeholder-qa.md`, adversarially reviewed) surfaced six refinements to the UNTESTED therapist value-model. Per the same-day "don't rewrite boxes for an untested bet" rule, these are recorded in the **Therapist value-model block + box-deltas**, not by rewriting the Problem/Revenue/Market-Size boxes.

**Decision:**
1. **Problem sharpened (client-side):** the gap is not "therapist can't repair" (therapists are skilled to get it and show it) but the client can neither **trigger** nor **receive** verification at the disagreement moment → the therapist's existing paraphrase-bid **bounces** → churn. Receptivity (lowering vigilance to the verification bid) joins triggering in Move 1.
2. **Arm A over Arm B:** therapist pays, client is **delivered** the intervention (story-verification → CPA), not sold a cold proposition. Client-paid "pre-therapy training" (Arm B) is killed — the trust barrier that keeps the audience out of therapy also blocks selling them training (value post-delivery, wall pre-delivery). Demand-side client test = "will they ENGAGE when delivered," not "will they pay."
3. **Revenue = certification (NVC/CNVC model), delivered as a scalable online course** — primary form (latent already in "coach certification"). Margin constraint: must productize (hand-delivery breaks margins). NVC differentiation: NVC structures the speaker; CP adds verified-understanding + calibration measurement + CPA pre-committed will.
4. **Market-size estimate (UNVERIFIED):** ~30-80k reachable relational/couples/EFT-Gottman/mentalization therapists; at ~€500 cert, 1-2% of 50k ≈ €250-500k — impact-business scale. Estimates pending interview + desk research.
5. **Safety/contraindication = `[FOUNDER DECISION: needed]`:** an async understanding-check into abuse/coercive-control, active crisis, or steep power asymmetry can escalate/coerce/create a paper trail. Needs a contraindication checklist + screening gate before client-facing use; obtainable via couples/IPV-screening literature + therapist interviews.
6. **Mechanism clarification (not a reversal):** async letter and CPA compose as the 5-move model — CPA = Move 3 (commit) feeding Move 1 (will); letter = Move 4 (decrease friction). The canvas excludes **silent-drift** (no articulable disagreement), NOT disagreement-driven withdrawal, which IS served.

**Falsifier:** (1/2) therapist PoC at a post-felt-understood rupture: client still ghosts/bounces → receptivity-via-CPA mechanism fails (= H-TherapistRetention mechanism gate). (3) no therapist will pay for a certification (vs a per-use tool) at any price that clears course-build cost → certification model wrong. (4) interview/desk research shows reachable therapist count or willing-to-certify fraction an order of magnitude below estimate → market too small. (5) therapists reject the tool on safety grounds absent a contraindication framework. (6) interview shows leavers leave via silent-drift not surfaced disagreement → served case is wrong.

**Alternatives rejected:** rewriting the Problem/Revenue/Market-Size boxes now (reverses the same-day "don't rewrite boxes for untested bet" rule — no new validating evidence); Arm B client-paid training (trust-wall self-defeat); per-repair billing (kept as proof metric only); pursuing the therapy-client→workplace cascade now (scope-expansion reflex — parked).

**Consequences:** Pricing amount + channel remain `[FOUNDER DECISION pending]`. Cert pricing holds only if "CP-certified" carries client-facing signaling value (brand we don't have yet) → early pricing is founding-cohort/lower. Next test unlock = therapist interview (gets language + contraindications + pain-quantification + cert WTP in one sitting). Objection ledger is the standing pitch reference. Expansion vector (therapy-client → workplace) parked under dormant segments.

**References:** docs/lean-canvas.md §Customer Segments (Therapist value-model + box-deltas); `.private/docs/business/stakeholder-qa.md`; builds on 2026-06-29 [product] (shift) + 2026-06-30 [product] (value-model + canvas-representation).

## 2026-06-30 [process]: Ship to main via a throwaway main worktree when the shared checkout is on another (dirty) branch — and watch for fix-branches forked off a live feature branch

**Context:** A fix branch (`fix/p980-…`) carrying three SECURITY DEFINER guard restores turned out to be forked off a **live feature branch** (`chore/load-bearing-tests`), not `main`. That coupled the histories two ways: (1) `git log main..HEAD` was 19 commits, not 4 — `git-ops.sh ship` would have dragged the whole feature body along; (2) the fix's own canary went **red** on a hypothetical main without the feature's P975 commit (the canary correctly detects the still-live `seal_and_send_letter` hole P975 fixes), so there was no isolated security-only slice to cherry-pick. Separately, the shared main checkout was sitting on `chore` with uncommitted co-tenant work, so neither a branch-switch nor `git-ops.sh commit-to-main` (refuses unless HEAD==main) was safe.

**Decision:** Ship by adding a **throwaway git worktree on `main`** (`git worktree add .claude/worktrees/wship main`), doing the `git merge --no-ff` (or doc commit) there, running pre-commit + tests in it, then `git worktree remove`. This advances `main` without touching the co-tenant's live checkout or their uncommitted files. Symlink `.env.local`/`.env.prod` into the fresh worktree first — a bare `git worktree add` doesn't, and the build fails on missing `VITE_*` env vars otherwise. To diagnose coupling before shipping: check whether the fix's tests/canary depend on commits not yet on `main` (`git log main..HEAD -- <test-file>`); if yes, the fix can't ship in isolation — merge the whole branch or land the dependency first.

**Alternatives rejected:** `git-ops.sh ship pN` (cherry-picks `main..HEAD` — would have pulled in the entire coupled feature body). `git-ops.sh commit-to-main` (refuses when the shared checkout's HEAD isn't `main` — exactly the concurrent-session case). Switching the shared checkout to `main` (clobbers the co-tenant's dirty branch state). Cherry-picking a minimal slice (impossible here — the canary needs the feature's P975 commit to stay green).

**Consequences:** The throwaway-main-worktree is the safe ship/commit-to-main path whenever a co-tenant holds the shared checkout on another branch. Prevention for the root coupling stays the existing rule (create fix branches via `git-ops.sh claim pN`, which forks off `main`) — this entry is the recovery path for when that's already been bypassed. Candidate to graduate into `.claude/rules/git.md` (Merge Strategy Matrix) if it recurs.

**References:** .claude/rules/git.md (Merge Strategy Matrix, One-Worktree=One-Branch) · scripts/git-ops.sh cmd_commit_to_main (HEAD==main guard)

## 2026-06-30 [technical]: The generalized SECURITY DEFINER canary had two blind spots — extended it to predicate-level + DROP/CREATE drops; audit found three more P952-class regressions (P977/P978/P979)

**Context:** The generalized `sd-guard-completeness` canary (entry below) was green against the entire migration set, implying no further P952-class drops. A full audit of every live SECURITY DEFINER function — building each function's migration history and diffing latest-vs-predecessors, then verifying each finding against the live prod definition (read-only Management API) — found **three** more functions whose latest definition had silently lost a guard an earlier version carried, all confirmed live in prod. The canary missed all three because of two structural blind spots: (1) it only accumulated `RAISE EXCEPTION` messages and named token patterns — it did not model **structural scope predicates** (a `WHERE author_id IN (...)` whitelist, a scoped `JOIN`, a return-gate variable), so a dropped data-scoping clause read as "no guard to lose"; (2) its function-header regex matched only `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION`, so a `DROP FUNCTION; CREATE FUNCTION` rewrite (P964) was invisible — the scanner never saw the recreated body and judged the pre-rewrite version as latest.

**Decision:** Extended the canary (`CRITICAL_PREDICATES` + a `CREATE [OR REPLACE] FUNCTION` regex) so it asserts each tracked structural predicate stays present in the latest definition, and it now sees DROP+CREATE rewrites. Restored the three dropped guards in one migration (`20260630130000`), each recreated from its current body with the lost clause re-added and all intentional prior changes preserved: P977 `get_letter_position_stories` (two-participant author whitelist — a third party's story on a shared snapshot point was returned to a letter participant; SECURITY DEFINER bypasses RLS so a private third-party story would leak); P978 `reveal_prediction_by_token` (per-listener + snapshot-scoped sealed-bid gate — a co-recipient's rating unlocked the reveal for a caller who hadn't rated); P979 `update_delivery_status_by_token` (forward-only rank guard — a token holder could drive their own delivery's status backward). Each has a runtime integration test plus the static predicate assertion.

**Alternatives rejected:** Trusting the green generalized canary (it was structurally incapable of seeing predicate-level or DROP/CREATE drops — a green run only proved the guards it *could* model). Keeping the whitelist-removal as a behavior change (the client already treats the affected slot as receiver-only, so restoring the whitelist is additive security with no visible change for real users — verified in `letters-service.ts`, not assumed).

**Consequences:** The canary now covers three drop classes (named-exception, structural-predicate, DROP/CREATE recreate). Any future recreate that drops a tracked predicate fails before shipping. The audit pattern (history-diff every SECURITY DEFINER function + prod-verify each finding) is the durable check whenever a function is recreated from an older base. Remaining: this fix must reach prod to take effect (the holes are live until deployed).

**References:** supabase/migrations/20260630130000_p977_p979_restore_dropped_sd_guards.sql · src/tests/sd-guard-completeness.test.ts · e2e/integration/20260630130000_p977_p979_restore_dropped_sd_guards.spec.ts · features/done/p977–p980
